messages:
Marta Alvarez: Quick heads up — Midtown Dev Salon next Tue 6pm. We have 2x 6ft tables, 1 demo station, and ~30 swag bags. Need final booth rotations, speaker confirmations, and swag pickup logistics. Please lock everything by EOD Fri.

Jamal Singh: I can cover 6:00–7:00pm. Bringing spare HDMI and a USB-C adapter.

Priya Nair: Speaker update — 5 confirmed (2 vendor talks, 3 community lightning demos), 2 pending student submissions. Ask to speakers: bios + 1 slide by Mon noon. I'll ping them.

Evan Chen: Swag status: tees ordered (S-XL), 100 branded notebooks, sticker sheets, and 200 candy packs. Vendor says delivery to 12 W 34th St, loading dock 3 on Mon 2–4pm.

LogisticsBot: loading_dock_reservation: confirmed for 12 W 34th St, dock 3, Mon 14:00–16:00. Driver to message #events-on-site when en route.

Vendor-Connect: Thanks @Evan Chen — we'll ask warehouse to palletize tees + notebooks separately and label "MIDTOWN SALON - REDWOOD". Please confirm contact name for onsite handoff.

Evan Chen: Onsite contact is Theo Ramos (cell: 917-555-0133). He'll be at the dock at 14:30.

Ava (events): AV check: venue provides 1 lav mic + 1 handheld. Demo station needs HDMI, power, and ethernet (guest network redwood-demo). @Jamal Singh can you test HDMI layout tomorrow?

Jamal Singh: Yep, I can test tomorrow 10am at office. Will bring a short HDMI->USB-C dongle.

Priya Nair: Speaker slots and current assignments:
```
18:00 - Doors/open mingle
18:15 - Welcome (Marta)
18:20 - Lightning demo 1 (Theo) 5 min + 2 Qs
18:28 - Lightning demo 2 (student) 5 min
18:36 - Vendor talk (ACME) 12 min
18:50 - Break / networking
19:05 - Panel (Priya moderating) 25 min
19:30 - Demos open at booth + closeout
```
Please review and flag conflicts.

Marta Alvarez: Love it. Two asks: (1) We need a lead-capture flow for inbound demo signups (QR -> Typeform -> CSV sync). @Evan can you create the short form? (2) Marketing table needs 1 person doing social posts/live updates.

Evan Chen: I'll build the Typeform today and share the short URL. Suggest fields: name, company, email, interest (API / Dedicated / Private), demo time preference. Also adding UTM param for campaign.

Theo Ramos: I'll take social posts. Planned cadence: 1 IG story before doors, 3 live tweet highlights, 1 quick recap post. Need 2–3 photos from setup.

Priya Nair: For speaker follow-ups, I'm adding auto email template. Anyone object to including a 2-min feedback form? Might help evals for Redwood Optimize narrative.

Marta Alvarez: Good idea — include a 2-question quick rating + one open line. Keep it <30 seconds.

Ava (events): Power note: only 4 outlets per table. Bring 2 power strips and a multi-outlet extension. Also bring gaffer tape for cables.

Jamal Singh: I'll pack 2 power strips and a surge protector.

LogisticsBot: Reminder: swag not allowed on stage. Please keep demo-only items at demo station.

Vendor-Connect: Shipping label request: please confirm warehouse address for returns and any leftover swag pickup by Fri next week.

Evan Chen: Returns/leftovers address: Redwood Warehouse, 45 Commerce Ave, Unit 8, NJ 07001. Schedule pickup for Fri 5/10 AM.

Marta Alvarez: Final checklist before EOD Fri:
- confirm speakers + slides (Priya)
- finalize booth shifts (see code block)
- Typeform for leads (Evan)
- AV test (Jamal)
- Dock reservation confirmed (LogisticsBot)
- Photographer on-site? (Theo to confirm)

Marta Alvarez: Booth shift proposal:
```
6:00–7:00pm Jamal Singh + Theo Ramos (setup/first demos)
7:00–8:00pm Marta Alvarez + Ava (social + demo handoff)
8:00–9:00pm Evan Chen + Priya Nair (lead follow-ups + teardown)
Teardown: 9:15–9:45pm — all hands
```
Please respond with :thumbsup: if you can make your slot or say which time you prefer.

Theo Ramos: :thumbsup: all good. Photographer booked (in-house) for 6:30–7:30.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: happy to do 8–9 for lead capture and slide sync.

Evan Chen: :thumbsup: I'll finish Typeform and share link by 5pm today.

Jamal Singh: :thumbsup: will test AV at 10am tomorrow.

Marta Alvarez: Thanks team — huge help. If anything blocks, ping me directly. Will post final run-of-show on Monday morning. :rocket:
